unverified: Facts taken from each film's English Wikipedia article (API/web_extract); cast/role pairs from cast section or infobox. Where a character name wasn't visible in retrieved text the character is '' (Wallace & Gromit, Constantine, Ju-On 2, Dead Birds, Dreamcatcher's Freeman, AVP's Bremner).
Hostel: article titled '(2005 film)' but states US theatrical release Jan 6, 2006 - included per article title; parent may move it to the 2006 slice.

Year edge cases: The Descent (UK Jul 2005, US Aug 2006), Wolf Creek (Sundance Jan 2005, Australia Nov 2005), Dead Birds (Toronto Sept 2004, US Mar 2005), One Missed Call (TIFF Nov 2003, Japan Jan 2004), Open Water (HIFF Oct 2003, wide Aug 2004).

Setting/villain fields paraphrased from article lead/cast snippets only; many settings left empty. Notes limited to facts seen in lead/infobox/cast text; no plot-section trivia mined, so notes are thinner than the 1990s pack.
Box office copied from infobox/lead; may be rounded or inconsistent across article sections (e.g., Land of the Dead infobox $47.1M vs lead ~$46M).
Genre-borderline inclusions: Constantine, Blade: Trinity, Hide and Seek, Corpse Bride, Wallace & Gromit, The Village, Identity, Alien vs. Predator, Doom.
Source ids: Saw cited as wp:Saw_(film) (page fetched via redirect); Wrong Turn as Wrong_Turn_(2003_film).

Considered but not included: Cabin Fever/28 Days Later/Ju-on: The Grudge (2002 firsts), Hellboy (2004), Red Eye (2005), Reincarnation (2005) - articles not retrieved; Taking Lives, Haunted Mansion (2003), Dominion (2005) retrieved but cut.
